questions.q: What is the little mermaid allowed to do for the first time on her fifteenth birthday?
questions.e: In the video: "Danas puniš petnaest godina, vreme je da iskusiš život." — today you turn fifteen, it's time to experience life.

questions.q: How does the mermaid explain the sun to Yoyo?
questions.e: In the video: "Sunce je ona velika, žuta stvar." — The sun is that big, yellow thing.

questions.q: What price does the sea witch name for the legs?
questions.e: In the video: "Koštaće te tvog glasa." — It will cost you your voice.

questions.q: What will happen if the prince doesn't fall in love with the mermaid?
o: She will turn into sea foam
She will stay on land forever
questions.e: In the video: "ako se ne zaljubi u tebe, sledećeg dana ćeš se pretvoriti u morsku penu." — if he doesn't fall in love with you, the next day you'll turn into sea foam.

questions.q: Why doesn't the prince want to marry the king's daughter?
o: He has fallen in love with another
He wants to become a captain
He is afraid of his father
questions.e: In the video: "Ne mogu da te oženim, jer sam se zaljubio u drugu." — I can't marry you, because I've fallen in love with another.

questions.q: Who does Arabella turn out to be?
questions.e: In the video: "Ali ja jesam princeza Arabela, kćerka kralja Donatela." — But I am Princess Arabella, King Donatello's daughter.

questions.q: What does the witch demand of the mermaid to reverse the spell?
o: Kill the prince after his wedding
questions.e: In the video: "Moraš da ubiješ princa u noći posle njegovog venčanja." — you have to kill the prince on the night after his wedding.

questions.q: What other way is there for the mermaid to survive and live forever?
questions.e: In the video: "Mora da žrtvuje sebe za drugog, ali ne smete da joj kažete." — She has to sacrifice herself for another, but you must not tell her.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.q: Sunce je ona velika, *žuta* stvar
questions.e: žut — yellow.

questions.q: A ono prelepo *biće* koje stoji na njemu
questions.e: biće — creature, being.

questions.q: *Povetarac*? Pa nisam od šećera, znate
questions.e: povetarac — a light wind.

questions.q: Idem na *površinu*, idem na površinu
questions.e: površina — surface.

questions.q: Imaćeš *noge* i izgledaćeš kao ljudsko biće
questions.e: noga — leg.

questions.q: Koštaće te tvog *glasa*
questions.e: glas — voice.

questions.q: Moraš da *ubiješ* princa
questions.e: ubiti — to kill.

questions.q: Onda ću sam da joj kažem da otkazujem *venčanje*
questions.e: venčanje — wedding.

questions.q: Hodala bih do njega i plesala ___ njim
questions.e: plesati sa nekim — to dance with someone («sa» + instrumental).

questions.q: Ali kako, kad nas dele zemlja i ___?
questions.e: The subject is in the nominative: zemlja i more.

questions.q: Ja sam doktor Kroki, naučnik, ___.
questions.e: After «biti» comes the nominative: naučnik, filozof.

questions.q: Ali loše odluke ne mogu tek tako da se ___
questions.e: After «da», a perfective present form: da se isprave.

questions.q: Znam da si dobronameran, ali samo jednom u životu ti se pruža šansa ___ pravu sreću
questions.e: šansa za nešto — a chance at something («za» + accusative).

questions.q: Moraš da ubiješ princa u noći ___ njegovog venčanja
questions.e: posle + genitive — after something.

questions.q: Kad je moj brod nestao u ___, mislim da me je ona iznela na obalu
questions.e: nestati u + locative: u oluji — in the storm.

questions.q: Došli smo zbog male ___
questions.e: zbog + genitive: zbog male sirene — because of the little mermaid.
